## App portfolio

- Context explorer showing why each item entered the token budget and what was omitted.
- Relationship graph with typed paths, impact, critical path, communities, redundancy, provenance, and time travel.
- Plan and milestone view with dependencies, decisions, discoveries, validation, and evidence.
- Assurance dashboard with measurement provenance, gate verdicts, negative controls, and recurrence families.
- Long-operation panel for task status, requested input, cancellation, and recovery.
- Every mutation leaves the app through an explicit SDK-backed MCP tool with preview, consent, authority, and immutable receipt.
- The app stores presentation state only and can be discarded without losing project state.
MCP Apps for pm: interactive graph, context, plan, assurance, and long-operation views with consent-safe action boundaries
Expose optional interactive pm views as MCP Apps while keeping authoritative state and mutations in SDK-backed tools and resources.

Each app reads authoritative SDK resources and never becomes a second tracker or mutable cache of record; All mutations use declared MCP tools with preview, consent, authority, idempotency, and immutable receipts; Graph and context explanations preserve typed edges, provenance, omissions, confidence, and token accounting; Accessibility, keyboard operation, reduced motion, large graphs, degraded connections, and stale data have explicit tests; Apps are optional extensions and absence never removes core CLI, SDK, or MCP functionality
Interactive context without creating a second project-management state
Render graph exploration, context selection, plan progress, assurance verdicts, and task state through standard MCP App contracts
Humans and agents can inspect complex project relationships and evidence interactively while preserving one immutable source of truth
MCP Apps are a notable extension and pm already owns graph, context, plans, tasks, and assurance primitives that benefit from safe interactive presentation
